def factor_tail_intraday_excursion_volume(df):
    """Accumulates downside intraday excursions weighted by volume surge; captures panic-selling stress."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    prev_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    downside_excursion = ((prev_close - df_copy["low"]) / prev_close.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.0)
    vol_ma = df_copy["volume"].rolling(60, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / vol_ma.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    stress_component = downside_excursion * vol_ratio
    factor = stress_component.rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum()
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    return pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index, name="factor_tail_intraday_excursion_volume")
description: Accumulates the severity of days where price trades below the previous close, weighted by volume surge, over 20 days. This captures panic-selling stress; elevated readings may indicate overreaction and potential reversal. The mechanism is distinct from prior drawdown/skewness attempts and uses intraday low vs prior close plus volume confirmation.
